finding: the best signal in this project was a measurement artifact of my own making

corrected_momentum_study.method: forward returns measured only on NON-OVERLAPPING rebalance dates, and the reference leg restricted to past losers so momentum is not flattered by simply excluding down-days
corrected_momentum_study.conclusion: no horizon reaches significance. The previously reported 'IC +0.0174, t=+2.93' does not survive correction.

two_methodological_errors_found.overlapping_windows: forward returns were measured at every date with 20-day horizons, so consecutive observations share 19 of 20 days. Not independent samples; t-stat inflated roughly tenfold.
two_methodological_errors_found.winner_bias: momentum returns were compared against an all-names average that included losers. Since markets drift up, excluding winners from the reference leg removes the entire apparent premium.

implication: every positive result in this project was produced by the same flawed test. The strategy-level holdout results were already rejecting them; the corrected signal test now explains why, and removes the last claim of a real edge.
status: research phase concluded. eight strategy families tested, none survives corrected significance testing or holdout validation.
artefacts_retained: information-coefficient framework, now with overlap and winner-bias corrections applied
